facts.text: Rollins' Finish in Four promise guarantees incoming first-year College of Liberal Arts students the guidance and course access needed to complete a bachelor's degree in four years.

sources.title: Finish in Four: Rollins' Four-Year Graduation Guarantee
sources.quote: Rollins' Finish in Four promise guarantees incoming first-year students in the College of Liberal Arts (CLA) the guidance and course access they need to complete a bachelor's degree in four years.
